timing_and_honesty.observed_before_freeze: The fixed h1/h5 summary paths for the full signal, its two ablations and the three existing polarity comparators were computed. h5 signed-materiality-times-novelty was the only 10-bps arm with positive net Sharpe and return.
timing_and_honesty.not_observed_before_freeze: No paired daily difference bootstrap, confidence interval, p-value or multiplicity-adjusted result between h5 strategies had been computed.
timing_and_honesty.status: Outcome-selected post-primary diagnostic. It can describe relative translation performance but cannot count as a prospective primary test or validated alpha.

selected_candidate: signed_materiality_novelty h5 fixed sparse top-positive/bottom-negative strategy
estimand: Mean daily net-return difference at 10 bps per side on the identical 501-session cash-inclusive pre-2026 calendar.
inference: Paired circular five-session block bootstrap with 9999 replications; one-sided candidate-minus-comparator greater than zero; BH-FDR q=0.05 across five comparisons.
confirmation_boundary: All paths use the fail-closed pre-2026 price loader. confirmation_rows_opened=0 remains mandatory.
claim_boundary: A favourable paired result would show that the selected h5 translation compared better with polarity-only and ablated translations in this development sample. It would not show positive alpha versus cash and would require untouched-date confirmation.
